normalization_plan.reason: The recipient address is only meaningful as the target of the balance credit inside transfer, so it is folded into that core function node
The amount parameter directly drives the safeSub/safeAdd state updates of transfer and has no independent semantics outside it
The source account parameter is only consumed by the transferFrom debit of balances[from] and allowance
The spender parameter is the address that is both approved and externally called back, so it merges with the callback core node
The queried account parameter only selects the storage slot read by balanceOf
The opaque payload parameter exists solely to be forwarded into the external receiveApproval call
The arbitrary contract address parameter only identifies the target of the owner-only external token rescue call
The nominee parameter is stored directly into the newOwner state and has no other use
The arithmetic operand parameter is a transient value consumed by the SafeMath helper and can be merged into it
The second arithmetic operand is likewise a transient value consumed by the SafeMath helper
The returned local of the SafeMath helper is a temporary result absorbed by the calling core function
